description:
£160 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the market this spacious eight bedroom student house, ideally situated on one of Jesmond-s most sought after streets.

Perfectly positioned to enjoy everything Jesmond has to offer, the property is within easy reach of a fantastic range of local amenities, including shops, bars, cafés and excellent transport links, making it an ideal choice for students looking to experience the best of this vibrant area.

With its prime location and generous accommodation, this is a fantastic opportunity for students looking for their next home.

Early viewing is highly recommended to avoid missing out! Contact My Property Box today and ask for the Lettings Team to arrange your viewing.
